user.title: Hamlet Pump – installation
user.description: 1 of 3: what kind of pump installation is this?

data_description.pump_type: Pick what this pump does. You can add another pump later – the Pumps page shows tabs.
data_description.name: Shown on the Pumps page, e.g. Borehole, House pump, Garden.
data_description.pump_switch: Shelly, Sonoff or contactor relay that switches the pump. Needed for a borehole. Optional for a pressure pump the VFD runs on its own (then the app only monitors).

sensors.title: Sensors
sensors.description: 2 of 3: map what the installation has. Everything is optional – the more you map, the better the protection and water readings.

data.floats_invert: Floats report the other way round

data_description.pump_power: Shelly power, or the VFD's output power. Used for dry-run / overload protection and energy.
data_description.pump_current: VFD output current. Use this for dry-run / overload if there's no power reading.
data_description.pump_hz: VFD output frequency. Above 0 Hz = pump running. Also scales the water and energy estimate.
data_description.running_status: VFD 'running' status or a pressure-switch contact. Optional – otherwise worked out from Hz, power or the relay.
data_description.vfd_fault: VFD fault code or alarm sensor. 0 / OK / off = no fault.
data_description.pressure: Pressure transducer or VFD pressure reading. bar, kPa, psi are converted.
data_description.flow: Flow sensor. L/min, L/h and m³/h are converted.
data_description.water_total: Water meter that counts up (L or m³). Most accurate water use.
data_description.tank_level: Borehole: the tank being filled. Pressure pump / irrigation: the supply tank (protects the pump when it runs low).
data_description.tank_full: ON when the tank is full.
data_description.tank_low: ON when the tank is low / empty.
data_description.floats_invert: Tick if your floats are ON when the water is NOT at that point.

zones.title: Irrigation zones
zones.description: 3 of 3: the valve relays and an optional rain sensor.

data_description.zones: Valve relays, in watering order. The pump only runs while a zone is open. Leave empty to just run the pump.

error.switch_required: A borehole pump needs a switch (relay / contactor) so the app can fill the tank.
error.zones_or_switch: Map at least the pump switch or one valve.

abort.already_configured: This pump switch is already set up.
